## Manuscripts in preparation

### Selecting and Estimating Credit-Risk Model Updates Under Distribution Shift {#distribution-shift}

**Silas Bambil and Shudeshna Nandy**

*Manuscript in preparation, 2026.*

Credit-risk models are developed using historical borrower information but applied to populations whose characteristics or regression relationships may have changed. Retaining an existing model may preserve systematic prediction error, whereas unrestricted refitting with limited recent observations may introduce substantial estimation variability.

The study compares retention, recalibration, refitting, and regularized estimation under common labeled-data budgets. Controlled simulations and historical mortgage cohorts distinguish the consequences of selecting an updating strategy from those of estimating its parameters.

[Applied project](projects.qmd#credit-risk)

### Selection Regret in Credit-Risk Model Updating Under Distribution Shift: The Role of Recent Labeled Information {#selection-regret}

**Silas Bambil**

*Independent manuscript in preparation, 2026.*

The probability of selecting the best fitted candidate does not fully characterize predictive performance. Incorrect selections may have limited consequences when candidate predictors have similar risks.

This investigation distinguishes candidate-selection accuracy from the predictive regret associated with selecting another fitted candidate. Simulations and historical mortgage data examine how the amount of recent labeled information affects these quantities under distribution shift.

### Tail Model Diagnostics Using Expected Shortfall and Bounded Loss Layers with an Application to Fire Losses {#fire-loss}

**Silas Bambil, Shudeshna Nandy, Clement Ampong, Prakash Karki, and Chi-Kuang Yeh**

*Manuscript in preparation, 2026.*

Agreement between empirical and fitted high-loss quantiles does not ensure agreement in expected tail losses. For high-excess insurance applications, model adequacy may depend on expected losses between specified attachment and exhaustion points.

Established stop-loss identities and an Expected Shortfall decomposition connect aggregate tail discrepancies to differences within bounded loss layers. The study develops diagnostic and inferential procedures for assessing where fitted tail models and empirical loss distributions disagree.

Simulation studies and an application to structure-fire damage records from the 2016–2025 National Fire Incident Reporting System releases examine sparse tail observations, influential incidents, and the distinction between discrepancy detection and localization.

[Applied analysis](projects.qmd#nfirs-analysis) · [Conference presentation](conferences.qmd#research-presentations)

## Completed unpublished manuscript

### ridgeShift: Evaluating Ridge-Regression Model Updating and Target-Sample Allocation in R {#ridgeshift-research}

**Silas Bambil, Shudeshna Nandy, and Yasmeen Babagana**

*Completed manuscript, 2026. Not submitted for publication.*

When a regression model is transferred to another population, a limited target sample must support both candidate estimation and model selection. Allocating additional observations to estimation may improve candidate predictors while reducing the information available for selecting among them.

The study examines this allocation problem within ridge-regression model updating. Its framework distinguishes candidate construction from candidate selection and characterizes their contributions to predictive risk through allocation and selection-regret decompositions.

Numerical verification, computational benchmarking, controlled simulations, and an empirical application to Beijing PM2.5 data support the investigation.

[Associated statistical software](software.qmd#ridge-package)

### Application of Extreme Value Theory to Fire Insurance

Undergraduate thesis, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, 2020.

Examined the application of extreme-value methods to the statistical modeling of severe fire-insurance losses.

```{=html}
<!-- ACADEMIC-TABS-SCRIPT-BEGIN -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){

(function(){

  "use strict";

  const themeKey = "academic-website-theme";

  const validTabs = [
    "home", "research", "software", "academic",
    "professional", "conferences", "cv"
  ];

  const code = "";

  const panels = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]")
  );

  const links = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll(".academic-tab")
  );

  const themeButtons = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-mode]")
  );

  const isHomepage = panels.length > 0;

  function storedTheme(){

    try{
      return localStorage.getItem(themeKey);
    }catch(e){
      return null;
    }
  }

  function setTheme(mode, persist){

    document.documentElement.dataset.academicTheme = mode;

    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = mode;

    document.documentElement.setAttribute(
      "data-bs-theme", mode
    );

    themeButtons.forEach(button=>{

      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-pressed",
        String(button.dataset.mode === mode)
      );
    });

    if(persist){

      try{
        localStorage.setItem(themeKey, mode);
      }catch(e){}
    }
  }

  const initialTheme = storedTheme();

  setTheme(
    initialTheme === "light" || initialTheme === "dark"
      ? initialTheme
      : (
        matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
          ? "dark"
          : "light"
      ),
    false
  );

  themeButtons.forEach(button=>{

    button.addEventListener("click",()=>{

      setTheme(button.dataset.mode, true);
    });
  });

  function selectTab(key){

    if(!validTabs.includes(key)) key = "home";

    if(isHomepage){

      panels.forEach(panel=>{

        const active = panel.dataset.panel === key;

        panel.hidden = !active;

        panel.setAttribute(
          "aria-hidden",
          String(!active)
        );
      });
    }

    links.forEach(link=>{

      const active = link.dataset.tab === key;

      link.classList.toggle("is-active", active);

      if(active){

        link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");

      }else{

        link.removeAttribute("aria-current");
      }
    });
  }

  function updateFromHash(){

    const key = decodeURIComponent(
      location.hash.slice(1)
    );

    if(validTabs.includes(key)){

      selectTab(key);
      return;
    }

    // Support pre-existing internal heading links.

    if(key){

      const element = document.getElementById(key);

      const panel = element
        ? element.closest("[data-panel]")
        : null;

      if(panel){

        selectTab(panel.dataset.panel);

        requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
          element.scrollIntoView();
        });

        return;
      }
    }

    selectTab("home");
  }

  if(isHomepage){

    links.forEach(link=>{

      link.setAttribute(
        "href",
        "#" + link.dataset.tab
      );

      link.addEventListener("click", event=>{

        if(
          event.metaKey ||
          event.ctrlKey ||
          event.shiftKey ||
          event.altKey
        ) return;

        event.preventDefault();

        const key = link.dataset.tab;

        if(location.hash !== "#" + key){

          history.pushState(
            null,
            "",
            "#" + key
          );
        }

        selectTab(key);

        window.scrollTo({
          top: 0,
          behavior: "instant"
        });
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener(
      "hashchange",
      updateFromHash
    );

    window.addEventListener(
      "popstate",
      updateFromHash
    );

    updateFromHash();

    // Improve links from one embedded subject page to another.

    const pageMap = {
      "research.html": "research",
      "software.html": "software",
      "academic.html": "academic",
      "professional-cv.html": "professional",
      "conferences.html": "conferences",
      "cv.html": "cv"
    };

    panels.forEach(panel=>{

      panel.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(link=>{

        const raw = link.getAttribute("href");

        if(!raw || raw.startsWith("#")) return;

        let url;

        try{
          url = new URL(raw, location.href);
        }catch(e){
          return;
        }

        if(url.origin !== location.origin) return;

        const filename = url.pathname.split("/").pop();

        const key = pageMap[filename];

        // Preserve detailed destination anchors on their
        // original standalone pages.

        if(key && !url.hash){

          link.setAttribute("href", "#" + key);
        }
      });
    });

  }else{

    const filename = location.pathname.split("/").pop();

    const standalone = {
      "research.html": "research",
      "software.html": "software",
      "academic.html": "academic",
      "professional-cv.html": "professional",
      "conferences.html": "conferences",
      "cv.html": "cv"
    };

    if(standalone[filename]){
      selectTab(standalone[filename]);
    }
  }

  // Visitor analytics: never activate on localhost or file URLs.

  const footer = document.querySelector(".nav-footer")
    || document.querySelector("footer")
    || document.querySelector("main");

  if(footer){

    const visitor = document.createElement("span");

    visitor.className = "academic-visitors";

    visitor.textContent = "🧋";

    visitor.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Visitor statistics"
    );

    footer.appendChild(visitor);

    if(code && location.hostname === "sdbambil1.github.io"){

      const endpoint = "https://" + code + ".goatcounter.com";

      const tracking = document.createElement("script");

      tracking.async = true;

      tracking.src = "https://gc.zgo.at/count.js";

      tracking.dataset.goatcounter = endpoint + "/count";

      document.head.appendChild(tracking);

      fetch(endpoint + "/counter/TOTAL.json", {
        credentials: "omit",
        cache: "no-store"
      })

      .then(response=>{

        if(!response.ok){
          throw new Error("Counter unavailable");
        }

        return response.json();
      })

      .then(data=>{

        if(
          typeof data.count === "number" ||
          typeof data.count === "string"
        ){

          visitor.textContent = "🧋 " + data.count + " visits";
        }
      })

      .catch(()=>{

        visitor.title = "Visitor count temporarily unavailable";
      });

    }else{

      visitor.title = code
        ? "Analytics disabled during local preview"
        : "Visitor analytics not configured";
    }
  }

  document.documentElement.classList.add(
    "academic-tabs-ready"
  );

})();

});
</script>
<!-- ACADEMIC-TABS-SCRIPT-END -->
```
